summary: Hostie (Hostie AI, Inc.) is an AI-powered virtual concierge for restaurants that answers phone calls, texts, and emails to capture and manage reservation and waitlist requests, and can book, modify, or cancel reservations directly in OpenTable.

Hostie's website lists named restaurant customers including Tonchin, Trader Vic's, Flour + Water, Slanted Door Group, The Stinking Rose Group, DACHA Projects, and Wayfare Tavern. (Scope note: Customer list is vendor-published; independent confirmation from the named restaurants was not obtained.)

Hostie integrates with OpenTable for reservation actions and with Perfect Venue for large-party inquiry handling; the company states it has been featured on CNBC. (Scope note: CNBC feature is a vendor claim; the underlying CNBC segment was not independently located in this pass.)
